subject.title: fix: slow session node delays sidebar for a minute

question: Should passive paired-node catalog polling coalesce an existing in-flight request per node/catalog owner before this deadline-based timeout behavior merges?
rationale: The change intentionally leaves the underlying request running for cache warming, but whether repeated sidebar polls may start another request before it completes is an availability and runtime-load policy choice.

options.title: Add single-flight coalescing
options.body: Reuse one in-flight paired-node catalog invocation for later polls while preserving the independent eight-second caller deadline.

options.title: Accept overlapping warm-up calls
options.body: Merge the current behavior while explicitly accepting that an unhealthy node can have overlapping passive catalog requests during repeated polls.

recommendation.title: Add single-flight coalescing
recommendation.body: Reuse one in-flight paired-node catalog invocation for later polls while preserving the independent eight-second caller deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch establishes the timeout/warm-up policy and is the most direct place to decide or implement its concurrency boundary.
